title: Customer discount is subtracted twice
premise: `compute_total` subtracts the discount twice while its contract defines one subtraction.

title: Checkout ignores a failed stock reservation
premise: no path in `checkout` reads the result of `reserve_stock`.

title: A granted reservation is never released when a later step fails before the ledger write
premise: no code path calls `release_stock` when a step after `reserve_stock` raises.

title: A notification failure after the ledger write reports a failed checkout; a retry books it twice
premise: an exception raised by `send_via` propagates out of `checkout` after `ledger.record` has appended, and no later attempt can detect the earlier entry.

title: The refund row has no amount and no VAT portion
premise: `record_refund` writes no amount and no VAT value to any output.

title: Lockfile contention fails the writer instead of serializing it
premise: no code path waits for, retries or handles a writer that finds `ledger.lock` already present.

title: A holder that dies leaves ledger.lock behind and every later ledger write fails
premise: nothing other than the holder's own `finally` ever removes `ledger.lock`, and that `finally` does not run when the process is killed.

title: The validation pipeline runs after its subject is consumed, and its result is discarded
premise: `step` runs after both `reserve_stock` and `compute_total`, and `checkout` does not use its return value.

title: A non-positive or NaN quantity passes the stock guard and inverts or poisons stock
premise: no check between the event payload and inventory.py:23 rejects a non-positive `qty`.

title: The order id is written unescaped into a tab and newline delimited row
premise: a payload `id` containing newline or tab reaches ledger.py:18 and :30 with no escaping or rejection.

title: `net * loyalty` becomes sequence repetition on mistyped input, allocating before rejection
premise: `compute_discount` receives `net` and `loyalty_percent` with their payload types, with no check before line 14.

title: The ledger's location depends on the process working directory
premise: the authoritative ledger location depends on the working directory of the process.

title: A missing or null order id is stored as an ordinary id
premise: an order without an id reaches the ledger write without being rejected.

title: Price and discount from the payload reach the ledger without type or range check
premise: no code between `Dispatcher.handle` and `ledger.record` constrains `net` or `loyalty_percent`.

title: A refund is appended without checking that its sale exists or was not already reversed
premise: nothing checks, before appending a REFUND row, that a sale row exists for the id or that it is not already reversed.

title: The receipt handler receives neither the total nor the VAT
premise: the object passed to `send_via` holds no computed total or VAT.

title: Stock lives in one process while the ledger outlives it
premise: stock has no store or rebuild step outliving the process or shared across processes.

title: The same net can yield VAT and total one cent apart
premise: `compute_total` returns different totals for orders whose two-decimal net after discount is equal.

title: `channel` documented as configuration is read from the order, and an unknown value fails only after the ledger write
premise: the handler key at notifications.py:14 is the payload's `channel`, looked up only after service.py:25 and :28.

title: Audit formatters render booleans and integer identifiers as money
premise: the numeric branch accepts `bool` and every `int`, and formats them with `:.2f`.
provenance: mixed (job-06-F7: extension to 105 functions from tools/big_module-census.json; job-01-F9 independent)

title: `_LOCKS` keeps one entry per sku value forever, even for skus refused
premise: nothing bounds the set of sku values that reach `_lock_for`.

title: Dispatcher ignores its own service; routing follows the last registration
premise: no `Dispatcher` method reads `self._service`.

title: A sale row has no VAT breakdown and no rate
premise: no ledger row records the VAT rate or VAT amount in force at write time.
